dedupe_keys.name: energy community aev charging station and household data considering pv generation and battery integration

description: A GECAD researcher publishes an Excel dataset for a 24-house energy community with rooftop PV, batteries, a five-point autonomous electric-vehicle charging station and a distribution-network connection. Zenodo lists one public workbook under CC BY 4.0. The description gives 15-minute demand periods, nine household appliance loads, 3 kWp PV at each house, several battery types, 7.4 kW bidirectional charging points, tariffs, transformer and cable data. These inputs can support integrated charging, local voltage or community-energy optimisation scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this combined household and feeder package. A limitation is that the public page does not say whether demand is measured or synthetic, the calendar date of the 96 periods, exact network impedances or vehicle arrival patterns. It names a community but does not establish operational deployment of autonomous vehicles. The workbook was not downloaded, and neither power flow nor charging schedule was reproduced.
